title: Billing & Cost Allocation — Export + Alerts UX: Wireframe notes & grooming
content:
Purpose:
Quick working doc for the billing console changes related to cost allocation, budget alerting, and data export flows. Goal is to capture UX wireframe decisions, edge cases for allocation rules, and a prioritized groomed backlog for the next two sprints.

Context / constraints:
- Customers want: per-project and per-model views of costs, export into accounting systems (CSV/Parquet/S3/BigQuery), and automated alerts when burn approaches or forecasted to exceed monthly budgets.
- Primary users: platform engineers (setting allocation rules), finance managers (review/export), and product engineers (debugging cost anomalies).
- Must support Dedicated & Private customers (sensitive exports -> S3 signed URL + restricted role), and Hosted API users (standard CSV export).
- Timebox: MVP for sprints 1–2 should cover manual exports, basic threshold alerts (actual % of budget), and simple allocation rules (by route, model, and tag).

Wireframe notes (high-level flows):
1) Budgets list view (console/billing/budgets):
   - Top bar: "Create budget" CTA, timeframe selector (monthly, quarterly, custom).
   - Table columns: Budget name | Owner | Scope (projects/tags/models) | Thresholds (50/75/90) | Current spend | Forecast | Status badge | Last export
   - Row actions: Edit, View timeline, Export (CSV), Run forecast now
   - Inline quick-set for alerts: toggle a threshold on/off without opening full edit

2) Budget edit modal / rule builder:
   - Left column: name, owner, timeframe, baseline budget amount (manual or recommended)
   - Middle: scope builder with pill-based selectors: projects (multi), model variants, custom tags (key:value), routes
   - Right: alert rules section: add threshold -> choose metric (actual, forecast, daily burn rate), notification channels (email, webhook, Slack), escalation policy
   - Advanced: allocation split (percent weights) for grouped budgets (e.g., shared infra cost split across product teams)

3) Alerts inbox and UI surface:
   - Alerts feed (console/billing/alerts) with filters by budget, status (open, acknowledged), severity (info, warning, critical)
   - Alert toast on bottom-right for live breaches with quick links to the related budget and to export recent charges for audit
   - Acknowledge button (for owners) + postmortem link placeholder

4) Export flow (console/billing/exports):
   - Export modal: scope (timeframe, budgets or raw charges), format options: CSV, Parquet, BigQuery, S3 (signed write), and destination config for BigQuery/S3
   - Mapping UI: allow user to map console fields to export schema (default template for accounting teams). Save schema as named template.
   - Schedule exports: one-off or recurring (daily, weekly, monthly). Recurring exports must show next run time and last run status.

Allocation rules detailed notes:
- Two modes: automatic (tag-first) and manual splits.
- Automatic: if resources have cost tags in request metadata (customer-tag:team=alpha), use that. Else fall back to route -> model mapping table.
- Manual splits: define a budget and assign percent shares to named cost centers. System must normalize so shares sum to 100%; validate and show recalculated per-cost-center forecast in the UI.
- Edge case: untagged requests should land in "unallocated" bucket and surface as a warning on Budget dashboard. Provide a quick assign action to reallocate historical charges within time window (last 30/90 days).

Export format specifics / sample columns (CSV template):
- timestamp, request_id, project, route, model, model_version, tokens_in, tokens_out, gpu_ms, price_per_token, price_for_request, cost_center_tag, allocation_share, invoice_month
- For Parquet/BigQuery include the same fields with typed schema and partitioning by invoice_month

Security & compliance notes for exports:
- For Private deployments: exports to external S3/BigQuery require admin approval and will be logged to audit trail. Provide option for encrypted-at-rest Parquet.
- Mask PII: avoid including user prompt text by default in exports; make an explicit opt-in and show a stern warning + policy link.

Acceptance criteria (MVP):
- Create/edit/delete budgets with scope builder working for projects and tags (manual test cases).
- Alerting: ability to create thresholds at 50/75/90% that fire emails and Slack messages; alerts appear in the alerts feed and can be acknowledged.
- Manual export: users can export raw charges for a given timeframe to CSV and download immediately.
- Allocation: manual split UI validates shares sum to 100% and shows per-share cost forecasting.

Priority backlog (groomed tickets):
- BILL-101: Budgets list and create/edit modal (priority: P0, estimate: 8 dev days)
- BILL-102: Alerts infra + backend thresholds (P0, 5d)
- BILL-103: Export CSV one-off (P1, 3d)
- BILL-104: Export templates & schedule UI (P1, 5d)
- BILL-105: Allocation rules engine (auto/manual) + migrate last 90 days (P0, 10d)
- BILL-106: BigQuery/Parquet export integration (P2, 8d)
- BILL-107: Private deployment S3 approval flow + audit logs (P1, 5d)
- BILL-108: Masking opt-in for prompt text in exports (P1, 2d)

Design/interaction tradeoffs / open questions:
- Forecasting model: do we use simple linear extrapolation or ingest hourly rate windows? Recommend layered approach: MVP linear, then refine with model that uses last-N days rolling slope. (Action: ask infra team for hourly token/time distribution sample)
- Escalation channels: support webhooks and Slack for MVP; PagerDuty only after enterprise buy-in.
- Templates: how many default templates to ship? Minimum: Accounting (CSV), SRE (detailed tokens/gpu), Finance (summary).
- Export retention for scheduled exports: keep last 90 records in UI; older available in raw storage. Need infra cost estimate.

Mockup micro-specs (for the design hand-off):
- Budget card compact view height: 96px; show sparkline of daily spend; click expands timeline drawer.
- Timeline drawer: stacked area chart (allocated vs unallocated) with mouseover showing request samples.
- Modal validation: on save, run allocation simulation and show "impact preview" table. Save blocked if allocation leaves >10% unallocated unless user confirms.

Developer notes / backend requirements:
- New DB: budgets table, budget_rules, budget_alerts, export_jobs. Exports reference raw_charge table.
- Alerting: threshold check should run as a cron every 10 minutes for hosted; allow near-real-time for Dedicated with event stream.
- Metrics: add new Prometheus/Datadog metrics for alert firing rate, export failures, allocations_unassigned_count.

Next steps / owner actions:
- Asha: consolidate final list of required fields for export CSV and circulate to finance (target: 2026-03-17)
- Tom: spike on forecast algorithm and return sample output (target: 2026-03-12) — blocked by infra sample data
- Design: deliver low-fi wireframes for list view, modal, and export mapping by 2026-03-20
- Eng: schedule backlog grooming session (BILL epic) and break BILL-101 into frontend/backend subtasks

Notes to reviewers (what I want feedback on):
- Is the allocation split UI intuitive enough for finance users?
- Which export destinations are highest priority for enterprise customers (S3 vs BigQuery)?
- Threshold defaults: 50/75/90 or 60/80/95?

Quick brainstorming scraps (rough):
- "Cost passport" idea: immutable per-request metadata that carries cost_center through routing — helps attribution for cross-service flows.
- Inline allocation suggestions: show probable allocation for untagged spikes based on top-k route/model ratios.

References / inspiration:
- GCP billing export patterns, Stripe usage export UX, our own previous usage dashboard (link in linked_artifacts).
